statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let primes := fun X => (w X).filter Nat.Prime; let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let short := fun (X D : ℕ) => (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => d ≤ D)).sum c))/(X:ℝ); let long := fun (X D : ℕ) => (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => D < d)).sum c))/(X:ℝ); ∀ X D : ℕ, short X D + long X D = (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p*ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (p+2))/(X:ℝ)

brief.en: Partition the divisors of each p+2 at d≤D.
